'''Trandosite Maelstrom The Merchant''' is a [[Light]] deck, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls54.htm Maelstrom The Merchant], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010227194546/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls54.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
